welcome_desc: Welcome to your venue panel. Would you like us to walk you through the first steps, or do you prefer to start on your own?
guide_me_desc: A short tour of the panel

steps.profile_body: Add the name, category, description and photos of your venue. They are what draws travelers' attention.
steps.review_body: Once your profile is ready, send it for approval. We will review the listing and publish it in the app.
steps.manage_body: After publishing, your venue will appear on users' routes, and you will see statistics and additions to routes.

error.something_wrong: Something went wrong. Refresh the page and try again.
